runs.label: Original Timm
runs.description: Timm's generator unchanged: the hooks are compiled in but every temperature is zero, so the words are his program's for seed 1; the pages follow the manuscript's page and line geometry along the route.

runs.label: Governed + innovator
runs.description: Source choice and mutation acceptance reweighted by the positional model's pressures (beta 1, horizon 256, four retries); 50% of the copies are taken from the 100 most recently used words, a running memory, instead of from the page; the slot innovator in place of Timm's paragraph-initial step; l and r admitted as word starts; pages follow the manuscript's geometry.

runs.label: Governed + innovator, far 0
runs.description: The governed configuration with no far supply at all (every source comes from Timm's page window), Timm's repeat check made once per position (--repeat-once) and no single word allowed more than a fifth of a draw (--source-cap 0.2); pages follow the manuscript's geometry.

runs.label: Governed + innovator, token pool of 2,000
runs.description: The earlier configuration: 50% of the copies are taken from the last 2,000 words written, weighted by how often each occurs there, instead of from the running memory of 100 words (RESULTS section 30 compares them). Statistics only.

runs.label: Governed, no innovator, far 0
runs.description: Timm's program with only the two hooks: source choice and mutation acceptance under the pressures, every source from his own page window (no far supply, no innovator), Timm's repeat check made once per position and no single word allowed more than a fifth of a draw, l and r admitted as word starts. The closest run to his original. Statistics only.

runs.label: Governed + innovator, sheet of 70 words rewritten twice
runs.description: 50% of the copies are taken from a sheet of 70 words kept beside the page instead of from the page. The sheet holds the first 70 different words of the text and is rewritten with the 70 most recently used words where Herbal A ends and Herbal B begins, and again where the Bio pages begin (--store 70 --store-at 11849,24384; RESULTS section 31). Statistics only.

runs.label: Governed + innovator, sheet of 70 words remade per section
runs.description: 50% of the copies are taken from a sheet of 70 words kept beside the page, rewritten at the start of every section with the 70 words that best fit what the model expects there (--store 70 --store-select pressure; RESULTS section 31). Statistics only.
